rule: Apply the existing codebook: a legitimising rationale has priority (framed), then directly expressed abuse/deception/evasion (explicit), then abuse inferred from relationships or circumstances (contextual). unassigned_policy: All 96 items were reviewed. A null label means this reviewer would request missing context before categorising it; these items are listed separately and are not scored as errors by A/B. Agreement percentages are descriptive similarity to this AI opinion, not accuracy.
